brand_identity.name: Kausar AquaTech
brand_identity.voice: calm, factual, no exclamation points, sentence-case buttons
brand_identity.art_direction: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level, restrained, minimal, premium, large kinetic hero, masked line-by-line reveal, real product photography with spotlight and clipped frames, numbered manifesto chapters, slow editorial marquee, purposeful motion.

headlines.style: refined, elegant, tight tracking for large sizes

primary.usage: cap, buttons, footer background, logotype, selected states, high-contrast borders

accents.usage: thin rule lines, dividers (1px borders), inactive elements

spacing_system.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to evoke luxury.
spacing_system.borders: Use 1px solid borders in #9AA0A6 (silver) for structural separation without heavy dropshadows.

visual_enhancers.cursor: Site-wide liquid cursor using Canvas metaball blob. Overshoot/lag physics. Bone fill (#F4EEE2) with Navy outline (#0B2545). Inverts when hovering over Navy sections. Add click ripple effect. Must disable on touch devices and if prefers-reduced-motion is true. Use pointer-events-none.
visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px silver lines (#9AA0A6) separating sections and bento grids.
visual_enhancers.photography: Treated deliberately. Use spotlight effects, clipped frames (e.g., arch or tight rectangular crops). Max height 80vh on mobile.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces only. No glassmorphism here, to retain a matte, tactile paper-like feel.

motion_specs.engine: framer-motion for React, lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_specs.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Delay: 0.2s, Stagger: 0.15s, Duration: 1.2s, Easing: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] (Custom cubic-bezier for dramatic smooth reveal).
motion_specs.scroll_reveals: Elements slide up slightly (y: 30, opacity: 0 -> 1) with view-triggered intersections. Use `whileInView` with `viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-10%' }}`.
motion_specs.hover_states: Buttons and links use color inversion or gentle transform (y: -2px). Minimal, unforced.
motion_specs.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee). High contrast text, uppercase serif or mono style, extremely slow speed (speed={20}).

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). bg-[#0B2545] text-[#F4EEE2]. Hover: bg-[#0B2545]/90. Font: sans-serif, sentence-case. Padding: px-8 py-4.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, border border-[#0B2545] text-[#0B2545]. Hover: bg-[#0B2545] text-[#F4EEE2].

inputs.style: Minimalist. border-b border-[#9AA0A6] bg-transparent rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:border-[#0B2545] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 transition-colors. Text: #0B2545.

step_indicator.style: Minimal text-based. 'Step 1 of 3 - Size'. No generic progress bars. Use uppercase labels with tracking-widest.

Home.hero: Large kinetic hero. 3D GLSL water splash background (Three.js/R3F) running behind text (40-60% opacity). Masked line-by-line reveal of headline ('Kausar AquaTech') and subtext. CTAs: 'Order now' and 'Design a label'.
Home.marquee: Slow editorial marquee separating hero from services.
Home.services: Three-up strip bento layout (Tetris style). Cards: Wholesale & retail, RO & mineral water, Custom labels. Use 1px borders, generous padding (p-12).
Home.trust_strip: Horizontal strip with partner/client text. Very minimalist, huge typography.
Home.footer_cta: Large banner. bg-[#0B2545] text-[#F4EEE2]. Massive typography CTA 'Start your order'.

About.hero: Company story (placeholder). Numbered manifesto chapters (01, 02, 03). Use massive serif numbers floating behind or next to body text.
About.manufacturing: Short factual statements. Bento grid of photos (clipped frames) and text blocks showing facility and quality.
About.photo_strip: Horizontal scrolling or staggered images of manufacturing.

Order.structure: Split screen layout. Left: Sticky live bottle preview (3D or layered 2D if 3D bottle too heavy, but try 3D R3F bottle). Right: Scrollable 3-step guided flow.
Order.steps: 1. Size (250ml/500ml/1L). 2. Variety (Mineral/RO/Scented/Flavoured). 3. Customization (cap color swatch, label paper texture, custom label text max 14 chars with real-time validation).
Order.summary: Order summary box pinned at bottom or end of flow. Quantity selector. 'Place order' button.

Contact.layout: Two-column grid. Left: Huge typography 'Get in touch' and contact form. Right: Branch addresses (Badnera 444701, Nandgaon Khandeshwar 444708), click-to-call phone numbers (8605629746, 9422549948), and Google Maps embed (grayscale/desaturated map style).

image_urls.description: Clean water storage and manufacturing facility

image_urls.category: Fallback for Hero or About imagery

3d_libraries.hero_splash: Use `@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei`. Create a custom shader material (GLSL) for the background splash. It must feature droplet impact, crown splash, concentric ripples, 6-8s eased loop, navy/bone tint (near transparent), 40-60% opacity. Render it as a full-screen fixed background in the hero section.
3d_libraries.liquid_cursor: Canvas based. Can be implemented with pure Canvas API or Framer Motion tracking mouse position with an SVG gooey filter (feColorMatrix).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: No generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling. Prioritize high-end editorial feel.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Must use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling (`npm i @studio-freight/react-lenis`).
Must use framer-motion for UI interactions and scroll reveals.
Use lucide-react for icons. No emojis as icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g. Order placed successfully, Form submitted).
Follow WCAG AA contrast ratio requirements. Ensure text over the 3D canvas remains highly readable (navy text on the off-white background with subtle splash).
instructions_to_main_agent: Setup Tailwind config with the custom colors: navy (#0B2545), bone (#F4EEE2), page_bg (#FBF8F1), silver (#9AA0A6), text_muted (#5C574A).
Set global body background to #FBF8F1 and default text color to #0B2545.
Implement the Liquid Cursor at the root layout level so it persists across routes. Hide native cursor using global CSS `* { cursor: none !important; }` (except for reduced-motion).
Create the Three.js Splash as an isolated component wrapped in `<Suspense>` so it doesn't block page load.
For the Order Page, build a sophisticated form with real-time state updates that affect the right-side preview (or left-side sticky preview). Include validation for the 14-char limit.

In the Contact page, ensure the Google Maps embed uses a CSS filter (e.g., `grayscale(1) contrast(1.2) sepia(0.2) hue-rotate(180deg) opacity(0.8)`) to match the brand palette, rather than the default colorful map.
Use Framer Motion to create the masked line-by-line reveal: wrap text lines in `overflow-hidden` divs, and translate the text up from `y: '100%'` to `y: 0`.
